widgets_values:
## Portraius Studio: make it real

The realism pass from Finishing: skin texture and a touch of grain on one still, at the app's default strength (80). The app calls Freepik's skin enhancer in its faithful mode; this is Magnific's Skin Enhancer node in its faithful mode with the same three settings. Magnific is Freepik's, so it's very likely the same model, but that isn't confirmed.

Put the still in `ComfyUI/input/` as `walt-diner.jpg`. `public/samples/walt-diner-real.jpg` is the app's result for it. The app scores the result against the character again; the graph doesn't.

Needs a Comfy account with credits: these are partner nodes.
